newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists get 266 bln lire worth of Italy CTZs.
newsitem.headline: Specialists get 266 bln lire worth of Italy CTZs.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for and were allocated 104 billion lire worth of 18-month zero coupon certificates (CTZ) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 200 billion, and bid for and were allocated 162 billion lire worth of two-year CTZs against an offer of 200 billion lire worth.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 3.722 trillion lire at the open auction for the December 30, 1998 CTZs against 2.0 trillion lire worth of certificates on offer.
The gross yield was 6.06 percent against 5.95 percent at the previous auction on July 10.
The Treasury received bids for 4.255 trillion lire worth of July 15, 1999 CTZs against an offer of 2.0 trillion lire. The gross yield was 5.99 percent against a previous 5.88 percent.
